scope: All64-bit slot/target values, all32-bit displacements, all canonical X86 states, every successful existing kernel signed32 round-trip acceptance; no program instance/literal/certificate or captured run.
implementation_contract: Rust x86.rs X86_HELPER_CALL_REL32_SLOT is E8,0,0,0,0; HelperCallRel32 patches record the checked slot offset, kind1 and target.
Kernel kind1 checks slot bounds, exact placeholder and final emitted IP, calculates target-(slot+5), round-trips signed32 and rejects truncation, then copies the four displacement bytes at slot+1.
checkedRel32 models the existing load-time signed cast guard. callBytes models those four little-endian emitted bits; canonical Reference.X86.decode supplies all ISA meaning.
claims: Successful signed32 relocation reaches exactly its bound target, for arbitrary PC/target values with architectural64-bit wrapping.
The canonical decoder recognizes the emitted E8 bytes for every32-bit displacement; the four-byte reconstruction is proved rather than postulated or sampled.
Every accepted emitted slot decodes to the intended canonical CALL with the exact fall-through.

rel32_call_preservation is an actual Composition.TranslationValidation instance with equality of the whole X86 state, preserving every canonical CALL event/fault/control behavior in the native-to-emitted direction.
relocated_call_reflects gives the reverse step implication, ruling out a different control/memory check introduced by this slot presentation.
The four-byte immediate patch preserves every code byte and initialization bit outside its range and changes no permissions, using the single reference memory writer.

validation.dependency_scope: Only generic Composition, canonical Reference.X86/Memory and standard proof tactics. No individual-program proof/certificate imported or used as evidence. Previously checked bpf-check dependency reused.

premises: Preservation applies after the emitter existing signed32 range check succeeds; this is a load-time transformation acceptance condition, not a new native runtime instruction.

Per-slot bounds/exact-placeholder/final-IP and code/entry/ABI/relocation-record binding must come from the actual native-link/kernel artifact invariants. This proof does not silently supply global record noninterference.
The kernel uses the supported x86 little-endian two-complement C profile for the checked cast/byte writer; kernel binding/emission implementation correspondence remains accountable.
remaining: Compose slot preservation across arbitrary well-formed relocation tables and the actual emitter/code/entry binding; the current theorem is slot-local and universal, not a complete native-link correctness theorem.
Other relocation kinds/ISAs, map lowering, general private spill erasure, helper identity/prototype binding and tail-call transformations each need their own universal preservation theorem.
Finish V native-to-token O1/O2 laws and generic compiler-to-actual-B preservation; then discharge the universal linkLaw required by generic_program_block_validation.
trusted: Single canonical ISA/Memory semantics and separate hardware fidelity validation.
Kernel binding/emission code correspondence and supported C/ABI profile.
